mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE board_tree (board_seq, ref_seq, reply_seq, "NAME", "TITLE", "CONTENT", hit, reg_date, depth, sort_order) AS ( -- 최상위 글 SELECT board_seq, ref_seq, reply_seq, "NAME", "TITLE", "CONTENT", hit, reg_date, 0, CAST(LPAD(ref_seq, 10, '0') AS VARCHAR(100)) FROM NEWBOARD WHERE reply_seq = 0 UNION ALL -- 답글 SELECT b.board_seq, b.ref_seq, b.reply_seq, b."NAME", b."TITLE", b."CONTENT", b.hit, b.reg_date, bt.depth + 1, CAST(CONCAT(bt.sort_order, LPAD(b.board_seq, 10, '0')) AS VARCHAR(100)) FROM NEWBOARD b INNER JOIN board_tree bt ON b.reply_seq = bt.board_seq ) SELECT board_seq, ref_seq, reply_seq, "NAME", "TITLE", "CONTENT", hit, reg_date FROM board_tree ORDER BY sort_order DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE NEWBOARD SET hit=hit+1 WHERE board_seq = #{board_seq}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT board_seq, ref_seq, reply_seq, "NAME", "TITLE", "CONTENT", hit, reg_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sort_order DESC) AS RN FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE board_tree (board_seq, ref_seq, reply_seq, "NAME", "TITLE", "CONTENT", hit, reg_date, depth, sort_order) AS ( -- 최상위 글 (Anchor) SELECT board_seq, ref_seq, reply_seq, "NAME", "TITLE", "CONTENT", hit, reg_date, 0, CAST(LPAD(ref_seq, 10, '0') AS VARCHAR(100)) FROM NEWBOARD WHERE reply_seq = 0 UNION ALL -- 답글 (Recursive) SELECT b.board_seq, b.ref_seq, b.reply_seq, b."NAME", b."TITLE", b."CONTENT", b.hit, b.reg_date, bt.depth + 1, CAST(CONCAT(bt.sort_order, LPAD(b.board_seq, 10, '0')) AS VARCHAR(100)) FROM NEWBOARD b INNER JOIN board_tree bt ON b.reply_seq = bt.board_seq ) SELECT * FROM board_tree ) AS tree_data ) AS paged_data WHERE RN BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
